comment: B54 blocked recipe for zap.c:zap_updown()'s concealed-hero upward branch. C confirms that the drop categories command selects all types with lowercase a and auto-drops them with uppercase A; the worn cloak falls to the floor when polymorphing. The garter snake is M1_CONCEAL and MS_HISS, passes can_chant(), hides under the cloak, and a Force Bolt `<` reaches the upward zap_updown path. Strict replay stops at input step 2 because JavaScript does not admit the C `D`/`droptype` command (`do.c:doddrop()`) used to unload inventory; no matching recording is claimed. The earlier attempt used `k` and reached only the northward weffects path.
